weekly_digest.headline: EPPO opens public hearing on draft PDP2026
weekly_digest.one_fact: The draft plan's common 2026-2037 build includes 24.3 GW solar, 2.7 GW wind and 14.5 GW BESS, with four longer-term pathways under consultation.
weekly_digest.why_it_matters: It resets the forward build envelope for generation, storage and grid investment, and will shape procurement opportunities through 2037 and beyond.

weekly_digest.headline: Direct PPA policy direction broadens clean-power access for industry
weekly_digest.one_fact: The Ministry says Direct PPA will allow industrial users to procure clean electricity through utility networks, alongside rooftop-solar and green-tariff reforms.
weekly_digest.why_it_matters: It can expand customer-led clean-power procurement and change the commercial roles of utilities, generators and large power users.

weekly_digest.headline: GULF starts commercial operation of two solar projects
weekly_digest.one_fact: Two Suphan Buri projects reached COD on 1 Sep 2026 with 135 MW of contracted capacity; additional solar and solar+BESS capacity is scheduled later in 2026.
weekly_digest.why_it_matters: It is evidence that the contracted renewable pipeline is converting into operating capacity rather than remaining only an award or announcement.
